description: Introductory lesson content: what a differential equation is (ODE vs PDE), the order of a differential equation, and higher-order derivative notation (dy/dx = y', d^2y/dx^2 = y'', ..., d^ny/dx^n = y^(n)).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 differential-equations lesson chapter (PHANKIMSIE booklet) — lesson definitions, theorems, and fully worked examples, photographed pages
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from photographed textbook pages (Claude Code), 2026-08-27

lessons.title: Order classification drill
solution_steps: \text{ខ. } y'' - 3y' + 2y = x+1 \text{ is a 2nd-order differential equation.}

lessons.title: ODE vs PDE classification
lessons.statement_latex: \frac{dy}{dx} = f(x) \quad \frac{dy}{dx} = f(x,y) \quad x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + y\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = u
solution_steps: \text{The first two involve an ordinary derivative of a function of one variable: ordinary differential equations (ODE).}
\text{The third involves partial derivatives of a function of several variables: a partial differential equation (PDE).}

lessons.title: Order of a differential equation
lessons.statement_latex: y' + 2y = 4 \quad y'' + 3y' + 1 = 0 \quad 2y'' + 5y' + y = 2 \quad x\frac{dy}{dx} + 2y = e^{2x}+1 \quad \frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} - 2y = \sin x
solution_steps: \text{The order of a differential equation is the order of the highest derivative of the unknown function that appears in it.}
y' + 2y = 4 \text{ is order 1 (highest derivative is } y').
y'' + 3y' + 1 = 0,\ 2y'' + 5y' + y = 2,\ x\frac{dy}{dx} + 2y = e^{2x}+1,\ \frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} - 2y = \sin x \text{ are all order 2 (highest derivative is } y'').
